narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we will dive deeper into solving systems of linear equations using the algebraic method, specifically focusing on the elimination method. We will also learn how to apply this powerful technique to solve real-world word problems. Our goal is to not only master the mechanics of elimination but also to understand how to translate practical scenarios into mathematical models that we can then solve. Let's begin by completing a previous example to solidify our understanding of the elimination process. We had paused at a point where we had successfully eliminated one variable and were left with a simple equation. Recall that we had an equation that simplified to y = 1 after the elimination step. Now, let's proceed to find the value of x. Once we have both x and y, we will present our final answer. This systematic approach ensures accuracy and clarity in our solutions. Moving on, we'll tackle a new challenge: finding the cost of items using the elimination method. Consider this scenario: The cost of 2 pens and 1 notebook is Rs 25. This is just the first part of a word problem, and we will learn how to set up the equations and then solve them using the elimination method. This will demonstrate the practical application of what we've learned.
